flavor_text: The crystal on this necklace's chain glows darkly with a profane energy. It was found near High Priestess Slikir after her defeat, and will grant the wielder more power for his or her spells, but at a price...
tips: Blood sacrifice works a little different than the official description. It actually deals 38 untyped damage in exchange for 50 spell points. This damage is affected by dungeon scaling, so while solo you will generally see (roughly as dungeon scaling does vary from class to class) these values 7 15 20 26 38 needs verification
